ideas.name: Startup Marketing Monitor
ideas.problem: Startup founders need to track competitor marketing activities without investing in expensive enterprise tools. This app provides aggregated public data on competitor campaigns, social media presence, and press mentions.
ideas.monetization: Tiered SaaS model: Free for basic tracking (up to 3 competitors), Pro ($49/month) for more competitors and detailed analytics, Enterprise ($199/month) for team collaboration.
